description: This file defines classes and functions for running and managing gtest-based C/C++ Android tests, including a test suite class, a factory for creating test instances, and methods for discovering test files.

classes.name: GTestSuite
classes.description: A test suite class for executing gtest binaries on device.

classes.name: GTestFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating gtest suite instances based on test files found in directory.

methods.name: GetTargetExecPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the gtest executable.

methods.name: SetTargetExecPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the gtest executable.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Runs the gtest suite with specified options and adb interface.

methods.name: CreateTests
methods.description: Creates test suite instances based on test files in directory.

methods.name: _CollectTestSources
methods.description: Collects test source files matching specific patterns from directory.

methods.name: _EvaluateFile
methods.description: Evaluates if a file matches test file patterns and adds to list.
